stage: 4L13 Retail resource lifetime and nested buffer maps
changes: Device-owned reusable texture frontend storage preserves immediate repeated Release without retaining backend resources. Exact-size free lists are locked, zeroed on reuse, bounded by peak concurrent wrappers per size, and freed on final device retirement.

Public API8 VB/IB nested locks count maps and union writable ranges. Final Unlock uploads once; mapped draws see the union. READONLY remains only when all nested maps are readonly. API9 duplicate-map refusal is unchanged.
ApplyStateBlock(0) succeeds without changing live state outside recording. Unsupported valid MSAA render targets return NOTAVAILABLE while invalid enums and lockable-MSAA retain INVALIDCALL.

acceptanceScope.projectOwned: Six VB/IB pool combinations exercise three overlapping-lifetime maps and independent full-buffer byte expectations; 1000 create/release/repeated-release texture cycles. CPU relocks are not GPU pixel comparisons. Native production-C fixtures inspect upload bytes/ranges and deferred final upload.
